{{Top|leg}}
The '''Miners Alliance''' was a union of various [[Realspace/Legends|space]] [[Mining/Legends|mining]] guilds for the joint acquisition of space resources.

Traders of the Miners Alliance could often be found on mining stations and [[Space station/Legends|space stations]] owned by corporations like the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] or [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement]] organizations like [[Corellian Security Force|CorSec]] and the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Security Forces]]. They often bought [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] resources from small independent miners.

==Behind the scenes==
With the addition of [[:w:c:swg:Space mining|space mining]] in [[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees|''Rage of the Wookiees'']], the second expansion of ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', several stations were added that gave players the option to sell their mined asteroid resources.
